flags.rationale: ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW is the primary live flag that directly enables shadow mode and causes effective_mode to become shadow and runtime branch to shadow_preview_path. Parser presence confirmed in config.py, runtime reachability confirmed in runtime.py, default value documented in defaults.toml.

ENABLE_PREVIEW_V2 is accepted by parser for legacy deploy manifests but normalizes to ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW. It is not a standalone runtime branch - it is a live alias that maps to the same shadow path as the primary flag.

PREVIEW_FORCE_LEGACY is only tracked for reporting purposes. Parser presence exists but runtime branch remains legacy_preview_path regardless of flag value. The flag sets force_legacy_seen but does not alter runtime branching behavior.

summary.note: PREVIEW_FORCE_LEGACY is dead code that only affects telemetry labels. Removing it requires updating legacy.py and removing parser hit tracking in config.py. ENABLE_PREVIEW_V2 alias can be deprecated after legacy deploy manifests are migrated.

cleanup_plan.rationale: Primary live flag for shadow preview rollout. Must remain for operational control.
Alias for ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW. Can be removed after legacy deploy manifests migrate to use primary flag directly.
Dead flag with no runtime effect. Remove after telemetry consumers and operator documentation updated to not expect this flag.
